title: Wireguard VPNs are inappropriately filtered out before other connections are active
line: WireGuard connections now show up in the Networks widget and can be connected even when no other network is connected.
explanation: NetworkModelItem::itemType() treated WireGuard connections like plugin VPNs and marked them unavailable unless NetworkManager's overall state was connected, so the applet's proxy model filtered them out while offline. WireGuard is its own interface that NetworkManager can activate without any other link, which is what the reporter does with nmcli. The change makes WireGuard connections always available, like bonds and bridges, and keeps the connected-state condition for plugin VPNs only.

commits.message:
libs/models: show WireGuard connections while disconnected

WireGuard connections were hidden in the Networks widget until another
connection was up, so they could not be activated first, even though
NetworkManager brings them up on their own. Only plugin VPNs wait now.

BUG: 489739

patches.diff:
From 8fd91f2f8088865e5cd01a94ed6665574511fe8b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:59:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] libs/models: show WireGuard connections while disconnected

WireGuard connections were hidden in the Networks widget until another
connection was up, so they could not be activated first, even though
NetworkManager brings them up on their own. Only plugin VPNs wait now.

BUG: 489739
---
 libs/models/networkmodelitem.cpp | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/libs/models/networkmodelitem.cpp b/libs/models/networkmodelitem.cpp
index 70d48fb6a..a57e07976 100644
--- a/libs/models/networkmodelitem.cpp
+++ b/libs/models/networkmodelitem.cpp
@@ -289,10 +289,11 @@ NetworkModelItem::ItemType NetworkModelItem::itemType() const
         || m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Bridge //
         || m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Vlan //
         || m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Team //
+        || m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::WireGuard //
         || ((NetworkManager::status() == NetworkManager::Connected //
              || NetworkManager::status() == NetworkManager::ConnectedLinkLocal //
              || NetworkManager::status() == NetworkManager::ConnectedSiteOnly)
-            && (m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Vpn || m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::WireGuard))) {
+            && m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Vpn)) {
         if (m_connectionPath.isEmpty() && m_type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Wireless) {
             return NetworkModelItem::AvailableAccessPoint;
         } else {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: NetworkManager disconnected, a saved WireGuard connection exists, but the Networks popup says "No available connections"
After: same state, the WireGuard connection is listed with a Connect button
With the fix, while NetworkManager is connected: both the WireGuard and the OpenVPN connection are listed as before
After pressing Connect while disconnected: the WireGuard connection is activated and shown as Connected
